## 7. Template identity (the core observable)
- actual_template_path (resolved): `.../scratch/repo/.claude/skills/atm-bd-orchestration/templates/cfgproof/sanity.xml.j2`; 1120 raw bytes; CRLF 0, bare CR 0, BOM false, LF-only true; strict UTF-8 decode ok (1120 chars).
- Contract attribution (verified read-only): atm-core tag v1.6.1 `crates/atm-template-sc-compose/src/lib.rs` line 25 `use sc_sha::{HashInput, calculate_hash};`, line 177 `calculate_hash(HashInput::TextFileBytes {`; v1.6.1 Cargo.lock pins sc-sha 1.6.1 (crates.io); `~/.cargo/registry/src/.../sc-sha-1.6.1/src/file.rs` `calculate_hash`: strict UTF-8, CRLF/bare-CR -> LF, other Unicode incl. BOM preserved, SHA256 over the normalized UTF-8 bytes. Python equivalent used: `hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8').encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()` (run with `python3 -I`, no verdict printed).
- canonical_content_sha (configured PATH)            = 48d980f7af74d1ebfd0c59d2a9f3bfc1acef7adea3f3be0a4366b3f987d77bbd
- catalog template_sha (`atm templates list`)         = 48d980f7af74d1ebfd0c59d2a9f3bfc1acef7adea3f3be0a4366b3f987d77bbd
- delivered template_sha (search `--template-sha` filter selecting message 01M52VC5DTD6502QNSHRXQN8J8 to cfg-receiver) = 48d980f7af74d1ebfd0c59d2a9f3bfc1acef7adea3f3be0a4366b3f987d77bbd
- raw-byte file sha256 (clearly labeled; equal here because the file is LF-only) = 48d980f7af74d1ebfd0c59d2a9f3bfc1acef7adea3f3be0a4366b3f987d77bbd
- All three equal. The basename control (raw sha 93d69fad...) and the shipped default (13a2666a...) do not appear in the catalog for type cfgproof-sanity and their bodies were not delivered.
- Limit: the search hit row does not expose a literal `template_sha` field; the delivered-message SHA is established by the daemon's `--template-sha` filter returning exactly that message (and no other), together with the catalog entry first seen at the message timestamp by fenix. The catalog stores `template_name: null`, so the custom name ties to the entry via type + sha + the delivered body marker, not via a stored name.
